description: This file defines the CardView class, a custom Android view that displays a card capable of flip and rotation animations. It manages bitmap images for the front and back of the card, handles flip animations horizontally (flipRightToLeft, flipLeftToRight), and supports rotations around corners. It also includes utility methods for updating layout, bitmap, and visual effects like shadows.

classes.name: CardView
classes.description: A custom ImageView that supports flipping and rotating animations, used for card-flip UI effects in an Android app.

classes.name: Corner
classes.description: Enum representing the four corners of the card for rotation pivot points.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CardView, loads the front and back bitmaps and sets camera distance.

methods.name: bitmapWithBorder
methods.description: Creates a new bitmap with a transparent border around the original bitmap for anti-aliasing during rotation.

methods.name: flipRightToLeft
methods.description: Starts a flip animation from right to left.

methods.name: flipLeftToRight
methods.description: Starts a flip animation from left to right.

methods.name: flipHorizontally
methods.description: Performs the core horizontal flip animation with given parameters.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Darkens the image to simulate a shadow effect.

methods.name: toggleFrontShowing
methods.description: Toggles between the front and back bitmap images.

methods.name: toggleIsHorizontallyFlipped
methods.description: Flips the horizontal flip state and invalidates view for redraw.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Updates the flip matrix when the view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the view, applying a horizontal flip if needed.

methods.name: updateLayoutParams
methods.description: Resets layout parameters after flipping to remain independent of previous state.

methods.name: updateDrawableBitmap
methods.description: Updates the displayed bitmap image based on whether the front or back is showing.

methods.name: updateTranslation
methods.description: Adjusts the translation of the card in the stack based on its position.

methods.name: getRotationAnimator
methods.description: Returns an animator that rotates the card around its center to a specified angle.

methods.name: getFullRotationAnimator
methods.description: Returns an animator that completes a full 360-degree rotation around a specified corner.

methods.name: rotateCardAroundCorner
methods.description: Sets pivot point for rotation to one of the four corners.

methods.name: setCardFlipListener
methods.description: Assigns a listener to respond to flip start and end events.
